messages.text: 🎁 Congrats! You've won a free gift card. Click here and enter your account password to claim it within 10 minutes!
messages.why: Free prize + urgency ('10 minutes') + asks for your password directly. Classic phishing pattern.

messages.text: Hey, it's Mom. Don't forget you have practice at 5pm today, see you after school!
messages.why: No links, no urgency, no request for personal info — just a normal message from someone you know.

messages.text: ⚠️ Your school account will be PERMANENTLY DELETED unless you verify your identity now: totally-legit-school-login.com
messages.why: Scare tactic + fake urgency + a suspicious link that isn't your real school's website.

messages.text: Your game update is ready! Open the game app from your home screen to install it.
messages.why: No suspicious link, no request for passwords — updates normally happen inside the app itself, not through a message.

messages.text: Hi, this is tech support. We noticed unusual activity. Reply with your username and password so we can secure your account immediately.
messages.why: Real support teams NEVER ask for your password. This is impersonation + urgency.

messages.text: Reminder from your teacher: homework is due Friday. Check the class portal you already use for details.
messages.why: References a portal you already know and trust, no links to click, no personal info requested.

messages.text: You're the 1,000,000th visitor! 🎉 Click NOW to claim your free phone before this offer disappears forever!
messages.why: Too-good-to-be-true prize + extreme urgency ('disappears forever') = classic bait.
